column3: Settled midfield early - made progress under 2f out - driven approaching final furlong and eased across right - urged inside the last with a determined finish drifting left - got up to score
Held up towards the back - moved through and angled left approaching 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong before edging left and losing out close home
Sat close to the front group early - urged into contention over 1f out with a clear shot - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Settled close up early - edged in front by halfway - given a squeeze approaching final 2f - overtaken inside the last furlong - held on well for fourth
Went straight to front - lost advantage by a whisker at halfway - stayed within touch and driven approaching final furlong - weakened in last 110yds to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - driven with over a furlong left but couldn't land a challenge - finished sixth
Settled midfield early - asked for effort with 2f left - unable to find any headway - finished well held in 7th
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort inside final two furlongs - dropped away with a furlong left - finished 8th
Held a handy position on the outside - asked for effort with over a furlong left - dropped away quickly - finished ninth
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort more than 2f out - found nothing under pressure - eventually finished 10th
Settled near the back - nudged for effort 2f out - well held in 11th
Slow into stride - held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 12th
Held up early - driven into contention over 2f out and up to third inside final furlong - rallied late to hit the front right on the line
Sat close to the front early - urged forward approaching 2f out - hit the front with a furlong left and driven out - kept battling but caught in the final stride
Settled midpack early - made headway 3f out to move into third with 2f left - driven to challenge with a shot at victory inside final furlong - kept on well but denied late by a whisker
Sat behind front group early - urged forward with 2f left - kept going without extra finish - finished fourth beaten 2 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven with over 2f left - boxed in and unable to find much inside the final furlong - finished 5th beaten 2½ lengths
Settled just behind the front group early - driven with two furlongs to run - lost ground final furlong - finished sixth beaten 3½ lengths
Went straight to front - driven approaching 2f out then lost command inside final furlong - faded to finish seventh
Tracked front group early - lost touch after halfway despite urging - beaten off before final furlong - finished eighth
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward around halfway - unable to land a blow through to the line

Set the pace early - challenged for command with 4f remaining - regained the front approaching the last furlong and a half - drew 3 lengths ahead inside the final furlong and kept finding more to the line
Sat second early - shared front spot approaching 4f out before losing it inside final two - stayed on at one gear to the line
Settled off the pack early - 6th at halfway - moved into 4th with 4f left - unable to close 2f out despite driving - stayed on at one gauge to grab 3rd close home
Sat close up in 3rd-4th before halfway - shared front spot 4f out - lost command inside final 2f - dropped to 3rd with nothing more to give - held that effort through - slipped back to 4th close home
Sat just behind the front group in 4th - up into 3rd before halfway - pressed for effort and dropped back 4f out - faded 3f out - never a factor - eventually let down well back and beaten a long way
Settled at rear early - 5th at halfway - pressed for effort 4f out and slipped to 6th - regained 5th but unable to threaten leaders and finished well beaten
Sat in touch just off the pace in 5th - slipped to the rear before halfway - eased and pulled up 6f from home
Sat just behind the front pair - driven into command a furlong out - kept finding to the line
Held up towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out and made progress - shared third under pressure inside final furlong - stayed on but couldn't reach winner close home
Settled around midfield - moved into fourth with three furlongs left - urged forward approaching the final two furlongs - kept on for third without the speed to get closer
Sent clear early - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - dropped away close home
Held up at the back - driven approaching 3f out - stayed on without threatening to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort 2f out - had nothing to give and allowed to coast home 1f out
Held up handy on the outside - urged forward approaching 2f out - driven and dropped away before the final furlong - finished 7th
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort at halfway - dropped away over 1f out
Took strong hold early - tracked front pack before dropping away 3f out - beaten off further out - well held at the finish

Set the pace early - lost the advantage approaching final 2f - pushed along with a furlong left - regained command inside the last - drifted right in the closing 110yds but stayed on strongly for the win
Set off in early stalking position - driven up to hit the front 2f out - challenged and overtaken inside final furlong - drifted right in closing stages to finish second beaten a length
Settled at back of field - pushed along and made progress inside final furlong and a half - finished well to take third
Tracked the pace - moved right for room approaching 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along inside final furlong - no impression made on the leaders finishing 5th beaten 4.5 lengths
Slow to begin - settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a blow - finished sixth beaten just over 5 lengths
Up with the pace early - dropped away 3f out and faded from 2f out - well held in 7th
Set the pace from the start - opened up a advantage before 2f out - kept finding under pressure to the line
Settled off the pace early - midfield around halfway - made ground into the straight - up to 3rd with 2f left but couldn't find more - grabbed second close home
Settled early towards rear - 8th at halfway - up to 7th with 4f left - crept into 2nd by 2f out but couldn't find more when asked - edged back to finish 3rd
Sat handy in 5th early - made headway 4f out to lead the chase pair 2f out - couldn't land a blow when asked late and held for 4th
Held up towards back early - midfield by halfway then 8th with 4f left - unable to make headway approaching final 2f - finished 5th holding steady effort to the line
Sat close to front group early - pushed along 3f out but unable to close gap 2f out - continued at steady effort to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace in third - moved up to second with 3f left - dropped back into the pack approaching the final 2f and could not threaten late
Sat close behind the pace early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped back over 2f out - dropped away steadily late - eventually pulled up well behind
Held up at the back - 9th at halfway - lost touch with the field 4f out - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - dropped away with 4f left - faded from there - well held at the finish
Sat behind the front group - driven approaching 2f out then went in front inside the final furlong - stayed on well to win
Handy behind leaders - driven approaching 2f out - jinked left inside final furlong - kept on for second but couldn't match winner's finish
Settled midpack early - asked for effort inside final two furlongs to make headway - fighting for third a furlong out - kept on same speed to finish third
Held up towards the back - driven up to make ground into contention 2f out - pressed the front group approaching final furlong - held on for fourth without finding more
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken close to the final furlong - dropped away late to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - driven from over 2f out - unable to close - finished sixth
Sat close to front group early - asked for effort with 2f left - lost touch steadily to finish seventh
Slow to break - held towards the back for the whole trip - finished well held in 8th
Sat close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - angled left approaching the final furlong - hit front inside it and kept going to win
Set the pace early - lost command with two furlongs left - fought back inside the last - claimed runner-up spot close home
settled in the pack - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on close home to finish third
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 1f left - stayed on late to finish fourth beaten 1 1/4 lengths
Pulled hard early - up with the pace throughout - moved to front over 2f out - pressed into the final furlong and overtaken - dropped away in the closing stages
Drifted right after the break - settled just behind the front group - pressed for effort and dropped back 3f out - faded quickly - finished sixth well beaten
Slow into stride - stayed off the pace throughout - well held in 7th

Settled towards the back early - began to make headway 4 out - up to 7th 3 out - made further gains after 2 out - into 3rd and pressed the leader over the last - went in front soon after and kept going for the win
Sat in third early - made ground into second by the last two furlongs - hit the front approaching the final fence for a moment - kept responding to the drive to finish second
Settled in the pack early - made ground three out - fifth turning for home - kept on to snatch third close home
Set the pace early - lost command nearing the final obstacle then stayed within touch of the leading trio - couldn't find more when asked and finished well held in 4th
Sat behind front group in 4th - made ground into contention 3 out - hit front approaching last - blundered there and lost slender edge then found nothing more late
Settled midpack early - 8th with three left to jump - shortened gap into the last two but flattened out approaching the final fence to finish 6th
Sat close behind front group in 5th - dropped back after 2 out - down to 8th with no threat near last - finished well held in 7th
Sat close behind the front pack in 6th - pushed along two out and error at the last while making no headway - dropped away to finish 8th
Settled near the back early - still down in 10th 3 out - unable to close from 2 out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - 9th passing three out - unable to close from two out and beaten well into 10th
Sat close behind the pace in second - dropped away after the second-last - faded steadily to finish well held in 11th
Held up at the back - unable to make headway - dropped away before 3 out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - lost touch approaching the final four furlongs and never a threat - eased out of contention before the last two furlongs
Held up at back of field - lost more ground before 4 out with no chance of featuring - eased out of contention approaching the last two furlongs
Settled at the back early - lost a bit of ground two out - driven into contention and closing fast inside the final two furlongs - hit the front close home - maintained the advantage to the line
Handy in the pack early - pushed along approaching 2f out then went in front with a furlong left - overtaken entering the last furlong - unable to find more and held for second
Sat behind the front group early - shadowing well into the closing stages before moving up to third inside the last furlong - held on for third at the line
Settled towards the back early - pushed to improve 2f out - progress gathered inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth
Held up in the pack - short of room and dropped back over 1f out - angled right and stayed on inside the final furlong - never able to challenge for a place
Set the pace early - pushed along approaching 2f out and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - faded thereafter to finish sixth beaten 3 lengths
Held a midpack position - asked for effort with 2f left but boxed in past the furlong pole - unable to find headway to the line finishing 7th
Handy early - urged on approaching final 2f then under pressure - lost place inside final furlong to finish 8th
Set the pace from the off - driven out with two furlongs left and drifted left while drawing clear - stayed on strongly to the line - won with something in hand
Sat close to the front - asked for effort with over 3f left - kept responding but couldn't reel in a strong-finishing winner
Settled midpack early - moved into fourth approaching 3f out - driven onward inside final 2f - stayed on to the line without getting near the front - finished third
Sat handy behind the front group - urged forward 3f out - kept battling on - held with little left inside final furlong - finished fourth
settled midpack - dropped back 4f out - soon well held at the rear
Held up at the back - failed to feature - finished sixth
Up with the front group - dropped away 4f out - far adrift 2f out
Urged forward from the start - hit the front after a furlong - driven and challenged with a furlong left - battled gamely under pressure through the final stretch - prevailed by a narrow margin
Sent forward from the stalls - hit front briefly before being overtaken after 1f - driven up to renew terms a furlong out - battled gamely through the closing stages - edged out narrowly for second
Handy early with the pace - pressed for effort inside final furlong - finished strongly to grab third close home
Sat close to the pace - pushed along a furlong out and drifted right approaching the final furlong - edged out of third in the closing strides to finish 4th
Held mid-pack - pressed for effort with a furlong left - stayed on at same tempo late - finished fifth
Squeezed for space early - settled towards the back - late progress passing tired runners inside final furlong but always lacking a real chance
Hampered start and drifted right - settled in the pack - pushed along with a furlong left but couldn't find further gears - finished 7th
Hampered leaving the stalls - settled towards the back - made progress inside final two furlongs - weakened close home to finish eighth
Pulled hard early - within range of the pace - pressed for effort 2f out - lost ground final furlong finishing 9th
drifted left at the break - settled in mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - well held at the finish

Settled towards the back early - still not involved and asked for effort 2f out - shifted left nearing the final furlong - found extra to hit the front inside the final 110yds - stayed on well to score

Pulled hard early - set the pace - pressed approaching 2f out and became embroiled in a prolonged battle - bumped and lost the lead inside the final furlong - no answer to the winner over the last 110yds
Hampered start - travelled strongly under restraint early - up with the pace - pushed along 2f out - locked in a battle with the second before bumped and unable to find more in the final furlong
Pulling hard early - settled midpack through the race - pushed along with 2f left - close to the front turning into the straight before weakening in the final 110yds
Settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left - unable to make headway inside final furlong - stayed on through the closing yards to finish 5th
Held a forward spot early - pressed for effort with 3f left before dropping back 2f out - faded in the closing stages to finish sixth
Pulling hard early - settled mid-pack - pressed for effort 3f out and faded inside the final furlong
Sat handy in 4th early - up to 3rd 3 out - pushed along after 2 out and moved into 2nd approaching last - hit the front soon after turning in - kept going strongly to score

Handy early - hit front from the off - overtaken 3 out - settled for second before regaining command approaching final two - slim edge at the last - caught soon after turning in but kept battling to finish second
Settled in third early - hit front three out - lost command between last two and slipped back to third near final fence - couldn't find more once in straight
Settled just behind the pace in 2nd early - dropped to 4th then 5th before 2 out - back up to 4th but unable to threaten approaching the last
Sat just behind the front pack in 5th - moved up to 4th two out - dropped back to 5th and faded through the closing stages
Held up at the back - 10th passing 5th - moved through before 4 out into 7th - unable to close from 2 out - eventually finished 6th
Awkward early - sat close to the front group in 6th - unable to close from 2 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards back - still 8th passing 5th and down to 9th by 4 out - unable to close from 2 out and well held at the finish
Sat close to the front group early - dropped to 8th before 3 out - faded late to finish 9th
Held up towards the back - hit the 2nd - lost touch four out - well beaten at the finish
Settled at the back of the field early - lost more ground three out - beaten well before the finish
Sat close to the pace early - urged along over 2f out and closed on the front group - hit the front approaching the final furlong - held off a determined rival to score
Fought for an early grip - settled handy - moved through strongly over 2f out - closed on the pace a furlong out - fought back inside the last - denied by a short margin
Sent clear early - came under pressure and lost the advantage inside the last two furlongs - eased back through the field to finish third

Hesitant start before settling into midfield - lost touch under pressure over 2f out - regrouped to close ground inside final 2f - closed on front group approaching the last furlong but couldn't quite get there - stayed on well for fourth
Settled in the pack early - holding a fair spot to 2f out - squeezed back approaching final furlong - responded to urging and stuck on late but lacked the speed to get closer
Sat just behind front two - asked for effort over 2f out to close on pace - driven with a shout inside final 2f - found nothing and dropped away close home
Held up at the back throughout - never a threat - finished 7th
Settled towards the back early - never able to make ground - finished well off the pace in 8th
Held up at the back early - progress into contention 3f out - up to third and driven approaching 2f out - hit front inside final furlong and pulled clear to win
Handy early - hit front 3f out under urging - overtaken entering last furlong - kept on at unchanged gait for second
Held up at the back - urged forward before 2f out and stayed on approaching the final furlong - moved into third close home - unable to threaten the front pair - finished third beaten 2.5 lengths
Settled around midfield - urged forward with over 3f left - flattened out under pressure inside final 2f - stayed on same gear to finish fourth
Up with the front group - ridden over 3f out without landing a blow - drifted left inside the final 2f before keeping on to finish 5th
Went straight to front - driven for effort and lost command 3f out - under pressure and fading 2f out before hampered
Held a midfield position early - lost touch and dropped away over 3f out - well held at the finish in 7th
Went straight to front - challenged with 2f remaining and drifted right approaching final furlong - kept going to the line for the win
Sat behind the front pack early - pushed along with 2f remaining - moved up to second inside the final furlong - stayed on well to finish second beaten a length and a half
Sat close to the front - challenged leader inside final two furlongs - drifted right approaching the last furlong - edged out of second but stayed on for third
Handy with the front group early - pressed for effort 3f from home - lost ground final furlong - finished fourth
Held up towards back - pressed for effort 3f out - dropped away - finished fifth beaten well over 13 lengths
Sluggish start - settled at back and pushed along with 4f left - well beaten by 2f out
Pulled hard early - set the pace throughout despite pressure - pushed along 2f out - stuck on well inside the final furlong to win going away
Settled with a strong grip early - held a midpack position - boxed in with two furlongs left - pushed along and angled right for room - stayed on well in the closing stages - nabbed second close home
Settled at back of field - boxed in with 2f left - eased left then right seeking room before closing to third close home
Settled off the pace in the pack - pressed for effort 2f out - progress inside final furlong - stayed on to take fourth place
Pulled hard early - up with the front group - met interference and no gap 2f out - progress to pursue the winner entering the final furlong before tiring and hampered close home
Tracked pace-setter through middle of track early - pressed for effort still holding position with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left and still in contention entering the final furlong - then dropped away quickly to finish seventh
Fought for control early - hit the front for a spell in the middle - up with pace until 4f out - pressed for effort 2f out then dropped away quickly
Settled close to the pace early - pressed for effort and dropped back 3f out - faded steadily inside final 2f - eventually well held in 9th
Fought for control early - shared lead before being pushed along 2f out - dropped away final furlong
Sluggish start - fought for restraint early - never a factor thereafter and well held in 11th
Set off in front from the start - held a narrow lead approaching the final obstacle - kept responding to urging to the line to score
Held up early - improved into contention 3 out then up to 5th before final fence - kept on well late - moved into second inside final furlong - denied by a narrow margin

Tracked the front group early - fifth turning into the straight - made headway approaching three out - up to fourth two out - third at the last unable to threaten the front pair and stayed on steadily to finish third
Held up towards the back - closed a little two out - 6th before the last - unable to threaten and continued on level terms to the line
Sat close up in second early - moved onto the front pair approaching the final fence - unable to find more once asked for a run entering the run-in - finished fifth
Settled around midfield - 9th passing halfway stage - made ground into 5th before 3 out - up to 4th by the last but blundered there and held to finish 6th
Settled in the pack early - up to 7th with five to jump - made ground into 3 out - briefly 6th before fading back to 7th and unable to threaten leaders by the last
Held a midfield position - dropped to 10th two out - unable to threaten the front group late on - well held at the finish
Sat close up in 4th early - improved to 3rd approaching 3 out - dropped away after 2 out to finish well held
Sat close to the pace in 3rd-4th until three out - dropped back before the second-last - faded to finish well held
Settled around midfield early - 8th passing the fifth then began to drop back four out - faded steadily from two out finishing well beaten
Sat behind the front group early - 5th passing four out - dropped back approaching three out - trailed off from the final two furlongs to finish 12th
Held up at the back early - lost touch and tailed off before 4 out - eased and pulled up before 3 out
Held up early - crept into contention before 4 out - dropped away before 3 out - faded soon after - eased to a halt before the last
Held up at the back throughout - urged along 4th - lost touch before 4 out - pulled up before the last
Settled in the pack early - 10th place approaching the 5th - lost touch four out - eased down and pulled up before the last
Settled handy early - urged into contention with two furlongs left - closed on the front group - asked for effort to hit the front a furlong out - sprinted away inside the last and scored comfortably
Set the pace early - overtaken 2f out then pressed and dropped back before final furlong - fought back to reclaim runner-up spot close home - held no answer to winner
Settled towards back early - lost touch with leaders 2f out - shifted right and squeezed for space over 1f out - stayed on strongly late to claim third
Sluggish start - settled last - pushed into contention with 2f left - gained ground over 1f out - unable to threaten those in front - weakened close home to finish fourth
Settled just off the front group early - pushed for effort with over 2f left - unable to close the gap - finished fifth beaten 4 lengths
Held a forward spot early - driven approaching 2f out - drifted left and dropped away inside final furlong - finished 6th
Fought for control early - travelled close to the front - hit the front over 2f out before being overtaken inside the final furlong - lost momentum late to finish seventh
Up with the pace from the off - moved to the front after a furlong - strode on with authority - driven out over 1f out and quickly put the race to bed
Went straight to front - lost command after a furlong and settled into second - asked for effort at halfway - outpaced by dominant winner 2f out - held on for the runner-up spot
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort inside final furlong - dropped away quickly to finish third
Sat close to the front pack - urged forward before halfway - unable to threaten and folded quietly inside the final furlong
Sluggish start - dropped towards the back - couldn't live with the pace and fell away - finished well held in 5th
Driven early to keep tabs but lost touch - stayed at the back for the whole trip - finished well adrift in 6th

Held up towards the back - bumped and drifted right approaching the turn 4f out - made gradual progress from 2f out - pushed along to close on the front group inside the final furlong - hit the front close home and held on under pressure to prevail
Handy early with pace - driven to front approaching final furlong - overtaken close home and challenged again inside last 100 yards - unable to find more and edged out for second
Handy early - hampered on the bend 4f out - driven up to join front group 2f out and moved into third inside the final furlong - stuck on but couldn't reach the front two at the finish
Held up towards the back - improved into contention over 2f out - closed on the front group inside the final furlong - stayed on but couldn't match the top three finishers late to finish 4th
Held up early - made ground wide from over 2f out - pushed along briefly before fading close home to finish 5th
Dwelt badly at the break and dropped well off the pack - stayed isolated at the tail early - began to close ground from 2f out - bumped briefly turning into the straight but stayed on to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - crept into contention inside the last furlong - stayed on to finish seventh
Went straight to front and dictated stiff gallop - driven when overtaken with a furlong left - lost touch soon after - dropped away close home to finish eighth
Held up in the pack - urged forward with 2f left and driven inside the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish 9th
Held a midpack position - urged for effort with two furlongs left then driven approaching the final furlong - faded to finish tenth
Settled in the pack - nudged into contention approaching 2f out - lost touch quickly through the last furlong and faded
Raced handy while racing wide - asked for effort over 2f out - drifted left and beaten for pace inside final 2f - faded to the back over 1f out and finished well held
Handy early - moved into second before halfway - dropped away and drifted right approaching 3f out - faded rapidly and finished far behind
Drifted right at the break - set the pace throughout and pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Tracked leader early - pushed along to press over 1f out - battled for second inside final furlong and stayed on to finish runner-up

Travelled with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked the pace - pushed along with a furlong left and battled into second inside the final furlong - unable to find more in the closing strides finishing third
Slow to leave - settled towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong
Settled at the back early - asked for effort and drifted right rounding the bend inside two furlongs out - dropped away soon after - finished 5th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along to close on the front group 2f out - moved through inside the final furlong to hit the front and stay on strongly to the line
Held up at the back - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on through final furlong - moved into second close home - unable to get on terms with winner
Travelled strongly early - shared front running and battled with rival from 2f out - overtaken and slipped to third close home
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early on - went to front but constantly challenged and battled with opponent to 2f out - overtaken and lost momentum inside final furlong finishing fourth

Drifted right at the off - sat behind the front pack - dropped away under pressure 2f out - rallied to stay in contention entering final furlong - shifted right and held effort to the line finishing 5th beaten 3 lengths
Hampered at the off - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late finishing sixth
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on at one gear through the final furlong - finished seventh beaten 5 lengths
Dwelt at the break - never troubled the front runners - trailed the field throughout - finished well held in 8th
Settled alone through middle of track early - drifted left to link with rivals 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish ninth
Sat handy in third early - moved to front three out and opened daylight over the final fence - kept galloping to the line unchallenged
Held up towards the back early - up to 5th before halfway - made ground three out - moved into second before the last - unable to threaten leader and kept on to finish second
Sat second early holding tabs on the front-runner - dropped to 4th nearing three out - couldn't find extra to close before the last - stayed on steadily to the line for 3rd
Sat just behind front group in 4th - moved up to 3rd approaching 3 out - unable to challenge by the last and held that effort to the line - dropped back to 4th close home
Held up early - up to 7th passing fifth - improved to 6th four out - 5th approaching final fence - unable to close and finished 5th

Went straight to front though scratchy at the first - opened a good gap from the 2nd until before the 5th - overtaken 3 out - dropped away after 2 out and faded before the last - finished sixth well beaten
Held up early - trailing and pushed along after 5th - up to 7th 4 out - stumbled 3 out - lost touch from 2 out to finish never a threat
Tracked front pack early - down in 6th by the 5th - slipped to the rear before being pulled up ahead of 4 out
Drifted right at the off - went straight to the front - driven and edged in front by a whisker 2f out - fought back gamely - urged 1f out - regained command 110yds out and kept going to the line

Bumped at the break - sat just behind the pace - roused around halfway - gained a slender advantage 2f out - drifted to the left inside the final furlong - overtaken 110yds out - unable to find more and held for second
Held up at the back - driven up to move into third inside final furlong - flattened out late finishing third
Slow into stride - settled towards back - pushed along with over a furlong left - unable to find headway late
Sat close behind the front group early - urged forward with over a furlong left - lost ground in the closing stages - finished 5th
Sat close to front pack early - pushed along with over 1f left - dropped away quickly - finished sixth
Settled in third early - moving strongly before hitting the front a furlong out - drifted right under pressure inside the final 100yds but held on for the win
Missed the break and settled near the back - boxed in with a furlong to go - found room and stormed into second - held on grimly for the runner-up spot beaten only a half-length

Held up in the pack - driven to improve into second with a furlong left - urged in pursuit of the front-runner approaching the last furlong - drifted right close home - dropped back to fourth - faded near the line
Settled towards the back within range - asked for effort with two furlongs left - edged closer late but faded before the line
Settled towards the back early - improved into contention over 2f out - drifted off a true line when pressed over 1f out - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish 5th
Settled just behind the leader early - dropped back 2f out under pressure - squeezed for space and dropping away inside the final furlong - well held at the finish

Took over early and dictated a brisk gallop - opened a three length advantage 4f out - edge shortened approaching 2f out then hampered and overtaken inside final two furlongs - drifted right and dropped away rapidly in the closing stages - finished seventh well beaten
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - lost touch approaching 2f out - rallied late to take second close home
Sat close to the front pack - asked for effort with a furlong left - unable to find more late and held for fourth
Sprinted eager early - set pace from the front - asked for effort 2f out - challenged in final furlong - stayed on well to prevail
Close up with front pack - shaken up and denied room 2f out before darting right to challenge inside final furlong - stayed on but unable to get past
Slow into stride - settled mid-pack - pressed on 2f out - boxed in briefly with a furlong left - closed strongly to finish third
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked the pace up front - pressed for effort 2f out - weakened close home to finish 4th
Settled towards the back - asked for effort with running room short 2f out - moved right approaching final furlong - stayed on without threatening to finish 5th
Held a position in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left before angling right entering the final furlong - stayed on at an unchanged rate to finish 6th
Settled towards the back - moved across left approaching 3f out - pushed along over 2f out - boxed in briefly - stayed on inside final furlong to finish 7th
Settled mid-pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished eighth
